versions.changelog:
Initial release of anime-storyboard-creator

- Generates professional-grade anime short/strip storyboard scripts for AI drawing based on user-specified grid format (9/16/25 panels) and character reference images.
- Automatically analyzes character style, visual tone, and genre from uploaded images.
- Searches and matches trending plots and drama segments from major Chinese online novel and comic platforms.
- Outputs standardized, structured scripts with detailed descriptions for each panel, following strict format and content guidelines.
- Includes optional AI drawing prompts for each panel and comprehensive quality checklists for script output.
